name: Johanan
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Ezra rises from before the house of God and goes into the chamber of Johanan, and eats no bread nor drinks water, for he mourns because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.

note.label: Ezra 10: The Covenant to Put Away Strange Wives
